The '''17C''' was a model of simple [[visual scanner]] manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]]<ref name="EGWT" /> The unit incorporated a [[Motion sensor/Legends|motion tracking system]] that allowed the scanner to track and follow the movement of individuals within range.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
